run_decide_device_auto: run decide_device with AUTO to select the best available accelerator device on the system
test_decide_device_cuda: test decide_device with a CUDA device string and verify it returns the correct cuda index
refactor_decide_device_fallback: refactor decide_device to fall back to CPU when the requested device is unavailable
review_decide_device_supported: review decide_device with supported_devices filter to restrict available accelerator options
summarize_decide_device_mps: summarize decide_device behavior when MPS is requested but not available on the system
